modes.title: Long Ago or Today
modes.skill: sort familiar tools by whether they belong to long ago or today

modes.title: Same Job, New Tool
modes.skill: connect an older tool with a modern tool that serves the same purpose

voice.welcome: Welcome, History Detective! Let's see what changed from long ago to today.
voice.sort-intro: Put each picture in Then or Now.
voice.match-intro: Find the new tool that does the same job.
voice.try-sort: Let's look again. Is this from long ago, or today?
voice.try-match: Almost! Find the new tool with the same job.
voice.pair-cheer: You found two tools with the same job!
voice.next-clue: Wonderful detective work! Here comes the next clue.
voice.gallery: Your time-travel book is full of clever changes! History Detective badge earned!
voice.idle-sort: Try the blue Then pocket or the purple Now pocket.
voice.idle-match: Look for the picture that does the same job.
voice.gallery-empty: Finish an adventure to fill your Time Traveler Gallery.

pairs.relation: A candle and a lightbulb both make light. A lightbulb does not need a flame.

then.label: Candle
then.alt: a beeswax candle in a brass holder

pairs.relation: A quill and a keyboard both help people write. Keyboards can make letters very quickly.

then.label: Quill
then.alt: a feather quill and ink pot

pairs.relation: A carriage and a car both help people travel. Carriages were pulled by horses.
A letter and a phone both send messages. A phone can send one in a moment.

now.label: Phone
now.alt: a modern smartphone with a message bubble

pairs.relation: A phonograph and headphones both play music. Both bring songs close to our ears.

then.label: Phonograph
then.alt: an antique phonograph with a brass horn

pairs.relation: A washboard and a washing machine both wash clothes. The machine swishes them for us.

then.label: Washboard
then.alt: a wooden washboard in a wash tub
